description.text: Physics is a fundamental discipline that studies the basic laws of nature, focusing on essential issues such as the structure of matter, the laws of motion, energy conversion and interaction. It is not only the core of natural science but also the theoretical cornerstone of the development of engineering technology, covering a wide range of research fields from microscopic particles (such as quarks and electrons) to the macroscopic universe (such as galaxies and black holes).

duration.text: The Physics at Northwest University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.
